input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also write /turn/ply.num exactly one greater than its current value, and must be signed by that agent's own key and co-signed by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so stale or replayed plans are rejected and no single off-plan agent can push a move alone.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("12", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
